title: dianthus collinus subsp. glabriusculus
intro: Dianthus collinus subsp. glabriusculus, commonly known as a subspecies of the fragrant pink-flowered plant, is a type of flowering plant in the family Caryophyllaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in herbal medicine for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Dianthus collinus subsp. glabriusculus include wound healing, soothing skin irritations, and reducing inflammation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
